username.description: Username must be unique; "all" and "here" are reserved.

from having no open WebSocket.

number.description: Number is the channel's short, stable link number (/c/12-general).

user_limit.description:
UserLimit is the most members a voice channel admits at once; 0 = no
limit.

parent_id.description: ParentID must be a root message of the same channel (thread reply).

reply_to_id.description: ReplyToID must be a message of the same conversation (quoted reply).

message_id.description: MessageID is the message to mark read up to; null or omitted means now.

mentions.description: Mentions are the users this message mentions (@username, @all, @here).

number.description: Number is the message's short, stable link number (/m/4821).

emoji.description: Emoji has no whitespace, control characters, '<' or '>'.

user_limit.description: UserLimit caps a voice channel's members at once; 0 removes the limit.

code.description: Code is one of the stable Code* constants; clients branch on it.

message.description: Message is a human-readable English message.

image.description:
Image is the original absolute image URL; clients load it through the
image proxy because the CSP only allows same-origin images.

latest_migration.description: LatestMigration is the newest applied migration file, e.g. "0012_message_count.sql".

pending_migrations.description:
PendingMigrations counts embedded migrations not applied yet (0 when
the server started normally: it migrates before serving).

credential.description: Credential is set for TURN only and valid for 12 hours.

username.description: Username is set for TURN only.

media_retention_days.description: MediaRetentionDays is 0 when media is kept until deleted manually.

update_check.description:
UpdateCheck is true when the server asks GitHub for new releases
(UPDATE_CHECK_ENABLED); the privacy policy then names the connection.

mem_alloc_bytes.description:
MemAllocBytes is live heap memory; MemSysBytes what the Go runtime
obtained from the OS.

password.description: Password is the admin's current password (re-authentication).

target_version.description:
TargetVersion must equal the latest release the server knows, so a
dialog opened before a newer release can't start the wrong update.

available.description:
Available: configured, an update exists, the image can reach it and no
update ran in the last five minutes.

configured.description: Configured is true when UPDATER_TOKEN is set (sidecar opted in).

image.description: Image is MNEMA_IMAGE, the image reference the app container runs.

next_allowed_at.description: NextAllowedAt is set during the cooldown after an update request.

reach.description: Reach says whether re-pulling Image can reach the latest release.

current.description: Current is the release version ("dev" for a build without one).

revision.description: Revision is the short git commit of the build; empty when unknown.

check_enabled.description: CheckEnabled is false with UPDATE_CHECK_ENABLED=false (no requests to GitHub).

check_error.description: CheckError says why the last check failed (empty when it worked).

latest_version.description: LatestVersion is empty until a check succeeded.

release_notes.description: ReleaseNotes is Markdown; clients render it as untrusted text.

release_url.description: ReleaseURL is the release page on github.com.

retry_at.description: RetryAt is set while GitHub's rate limit pauses the checks.

enabled.description: Enabled is false when the SFU could not start (voice disabled).

media_connections.description: MediaConnections are the SFU's peer connections.

rooms.description: Rooms and Participants are the calls as members see them.

websocket_connections.description:
WebSocketConnections are open realtime connections; OnlineUsers the
distinct users behind them.

cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly session cookie issued by POST /api/auth/login or /api/auth/register. The name is __Host-mnema_session when PUBLIC_URL is https.
cookieAuth.name: mnema_session

info.description:
REST API of Mnema Talk, a self-hosted, invite-only chat and voice app for a single community.
Authentication is an HttpOnly session cookie set by login/register. State-changing requests (anything but GET/HEAD/OPTIONS) must carry a same-origin Origin header, otherwise 403.
JSON bodies are decoded strictly: unknown fields are rejected with 400 and bodies are limited to 1 MiB. Errors share the ErrorResponse shape.
Everything except the SPA assets lives under /api.

get.description:
Upgrades to a WebSocket (requires a same-origin Origin header; a foreign origin is refused with 403 by the upgrade handler). OpenAPI cannot model WebSocket frames, so the protocol is described here.

Every frame in both directions is a JSON text message `{"type": string, "payload": any}`. At most a few events per second per connection are processed; excess client events are dropped.

Server to client, on connect (to this connection only):
- `presence_snapshot`: map of user id to live status for every online user.
- `voice_snapshot`: map of voice channel id to a map of user id to User plus `joined_at`.
- `voice_rooms`: `{started: {channelId: time}, now}`; the server clock lets clients count up.

Server to client, broadcast to all connections:
- `message_create`, `message_update`: Message.
- `message_delete`: `{id, channel_id, parent_id}`.
- `message_reaction`: `{message_id, reactions}`.
- `channels_changed`: no payload; refetch GET /api/channels (sent after any category/channel/layout admin change).
- `member_joined`: public User of a newly registered member.
- `user_update`: public User after a profile, status or avatar change, or `{id, disabled}` when an admin disables or enables an account.
- `user_stats`: `{user_id, voice_seconds}` after a voice stay ends.
- `presence_update`: `{user_id, status}` where status is online, away, dnd, focus or offline.
- `voice_state_update`: `{action: "join", channel_id, user, started_at}` or `{action: "leave", channel_id, user_id}`.
- `typing`: `{channel_id, user_id}` (to everyone except the typist).

Server to client, targeted:
- `read_state`: to the user's own sessions only; `{channel_id, last_read_at, unread_count, mention_count}`, `{channel_id, last_read_at, refresh: true}` or `{channel_id, notify_level}`.
- `webrtc_media_state`: `{channel_id, user_id, screen, camera}` to voice-room members.
- `voice_speaking`: `{channel_id, user_id, active}` to voice-room members, only when the state changes.
- `screen_viewers`: `{channel_id, user_id, viewers}` to voice-room members: `viewers` are the distinct users in the room watching `user_id`'s screen share (sorted ids, never the sharer). Sent whenever that set changes (`viewers: []` once when a watched share ends or loses its last viewer), and on `voice_join` one per live share to the joining connection only.
- `webrtc_offer` (SDP offer), `webrtc_candidate` (ICE candidate): SFU signalling.
- `voice_kicked`: `{channel_id, reason?}` when an admin removes the user from voice, or `reason: "room_full"` when a voice join is refused because the room is full (the channel's `user_limit`).
- `pong`: `{t}` echoing a `ping`.

Client to server:
- `ping` `{t}`; `presence_idle` `{idle: bool}`.
- `typing` `{channel_id}` (text and voice channels, rate-limited).
- `voice_join` `{channel_id}`; `voice_leave`; `voice_speaking` `{active}`.
- `webrtc_answer` (SDP answer), `webrtc_candidate` (ICE candidate), `webrtc_request_keyframe`.
- `webrtc_subscribe` `{kind: "screen"|"camera", user_id, on}` or `{kind: "camera", all: true, on}`.
- `webrtc_screenshare_stop`, `webrtc_camera_stop`.

Unknown event types are ignored. The server closes the connection when the session is revoked or the account is disabled.
